page_title: Brink: Your pages, on the edge.

summary.name: Brink
summary.one_liner: Brink is a free menu-bar-style notch app for Mac and Windows that puts your Notion pages and tasks on a strip at the screen edge, one hover away.
keywords: notion pages on edge of screen
use_cases: Check off Notion tasks without opening the full app
Capture a task quickly from any app with a hotkey
Keep pinned Notion pages one hover away
Glance at today's due items from the screen edge
Send links or files to Notion pages from a share menu
Pin a filtered Notion database view to the desktop
summary.what_it_does: Brink adds a black notch along the left, right or top screen edge on macOS and Windows. Hovering reveals a strip of pinned Notion pages and tasks, where you can peek at items, tick off to-dos and see due-today badges. A global hotkey (⌥⇧Space on Mac) opens quick capture, which accepts natural dates in English and Czech. Pages open in a Markdown-style block editor that converts syntax like [] and ## into checkboxes and headings. On Mac it can also connect to Apple Notes and offers a menu-bar list and a desktop widget.
notable: Hover-revealed notch strip with pinned Notion pages and tasks
Quick capture hotkey with natural date parsing in English and Czech
Token stored in macOS Keychain; no analytics or tracking
Apple Notes support on Mac only
caveats: Mac build is not notarized, so first launch requires right-click → Open
Windows installer is unsigned and may trigger SmartScreen
Apple Notes integration is Mac only
